positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Compliance with new legislation, switch from Twilio to Bandwidth, Node upgrade, and release management of open-source text-distribution tool Spoke
-Lead implementation of Secrets Manager, credential auto-rotation, and base image deployment standard for AWS Lambda functions
-Create Auth0, Google Admin, and Shopify ETL connectors for the open-source Parsons library
-Restructure EC2 instance used by Analytics for modeling and experimentation to improve usability
-Harden and scale production systems appropriately for variable traffic throughout election cycle
-Implement redesign of outdated web pages
-Automate member data deletion, call center data parsing, and money transfer between financial entities
-Develop and deploy Apple Pay payment method for MoveOn's donation pages
-Write and maintain tests for various code repos (Cypress, Jest, Selenium)

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
-Develop automation processes to onboard new bases into the Air Force Comptroller Services Portal (CSP). Reduced onboarding time by a factor of 12
-Responsible for onboarding 34 new bases across North America, Europe, and Asia into CSP
-Build a JS library to automate PII redaction in user uploaded documents
-Visualize the massive Air Force organization structure (~17,000 nodes) using D3.js
-Develop a scoring system for Air Force comptroller squadrons
-Replace Architect of the Capitol’s outdated order tracking process with a streamlined web application
positions.insights: Skills: Bootstrap · jQuery · JavaScript · HTML · CSS · SQL · REST APIs
